$comment: SkyyRose V2 motion/responsive implementation contract. This describes required behavior; it is not runtime proof.

allowed: guide attention to the next editorial chapter
preserve spatial continuity between related content
purpose.rule: If motion does not guide attention, communicate state, or preserve continuity, omit it. Motion is always an after-effect of a usable state.

prohibited_patterns: garment-competing particles, aurora, or gradient mesh

behavior_matrix.purpose: Expose navigation, search, account, bag, and service paths without obscuring the page.

390.motion: short opacity/transform open; no backdrop dependency

768.layout: compact or two-row masthead; drawer remains modal

1440.motion: optional opacity/transform drawer; no layout animation

behavior_matrix.trigger: explicit click, tap, or keyboard activation
behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: instant open/close with identical DOM, names, order, and focus path

behavior_matrix.purpose: Guide attention to an authored editorial chapter while preserving immediate content access.

390.layout: one-column portrait art and linear content
390.motion: no sticky, parallax, or hover dependency

768.layout: tablet editorial composition; two columns only when content fits

1440.crop: wide thesis crop with commerce interruption
1440.motion: one authored text/image reveal; no global cascade

behavior_matrix.trigger: IntersectionObserver visibility threshold or explicit skip
behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: final image/text order is visible immediately; headings, product facts, and CTA remain in the same DOM order

behavior_matrix.purpose: Preserve spatial continuity between visual evidence and reading or purchase decisions.

390.layout: normal flow; media then evidence and CTA

768.sticky: opt-in; fall back to normal flow if it can obscure focused content

behavior_matrix.trigger: both columns measurable and viewport eligible
behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: normal document flow with identical captions and product links

behavior_matrix.purpose: Connect an authored image to exact, available product records.

390.layout: captioned image followed by ordered product list

768.layout: product list first; optional static coordinate markers

1440.layout: labeled image hotspots plus adjacent product ledger
1440.hotspots: enabled only with approved coordinates and DOM ledger

behavior_matrix.trigger: explicit activation of a labeled hotspot or product link
behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: captioned image and all product cards remain visible without coordinate animation

behavior_matrix.purpose: Prove fit, material, movement, and construction without speculative media.

768.layout: static gallery first; 360 only after explicit gesture

1440.layout: two-up verified gallery; optional 36-72 frame viewer after activation

behavior_matrix.trigger: visibility for poster; explicit click/tap/keyboard intent for 360
behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: static multi-angle gallery, alt text, specifications, and unchanged Add to Bag path

behavior_matrix.purpose: Communicate request state immediately and unambiguously.

1440.layout: rose-gold primary with restrained underline secondary
1440.state: same explicit states; no magnetic movement

behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: status text/live-region feedback appears with no transition delay; purchase and service actions never wait for motion

behavior_matrix.purpose: Offer optional discovery while keeping a direct, non-urgent route to shop.

390.layout: poster, transcript, and Skip to shop near title

behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: linear lookbook and exact product links with no dark-pattern timer

behavior_matrix.purpose: Provide an optional memorable place while keeping DOM commerce primary.

390.commerce: DOM heading, facts, and Shop CTA

768.webgl: poster first; opt-in only on capable device

1440.webgl: lazy initialize after poster/LCP and explicit capability check

behavior_matrix.trigger: poster visible, capability check passes, and user intent where required
behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: static poster, editorial chapter scroll, and Shop CTA with identical product facts

behavior_matrix.purpose: Add atmosphere only after an explicit user choice, with transcript parity.
behavior_matrix.trigger: click, tap, or keyboard activation only
behavior_matrix.reduced_motion_equivalence: visual chapter, stills, and transcript; no autoplay

touch_rules: no gesture hijack or page lock
live_region_rules: loading, success, error, and unavailable states are announced
focus_keyboard_touch_contract.focused_content_rule: Never move focused content offscreen or underneath a sticky control.

reduced_motion.equivalence: Equivalent usable composition is required; a blank or missing placeholder is not a reduced-motion fallback.
reduced_motion.preference_change: Cancel in-flight motion and media work, then render the equivalent static state.

initialize_policy.1440: lazy after poster/LCP and capability check

no_webgl_fallback.proof: Stub unavailable canvas context and induce every failure state; assert poster, status, facts, CTA, and keyboard reachability remain visible.

budgets.document_overflow: documentElement.scrollWidth equals clientWidth at 390, 768, and 1440; only explicitly labeled inner table/rail scrollers may overflow.
image_requirements: no eager gallery beyond LCP candidate

evidence_artifacts.binding: Every artifact shares one candidate_id and stable data-feature-id. Missing or stale evidence is UNKNOWN and cannot satisfy release readiness.

must_assert: equal DOM order and CTA reachability

evidence_artifacts.release_gate: All required artifacts must be present, candidate-bound, fresh for the implementation, and PASS. UNKNOWN, BLOCKED, stale, or missing evidence fails closed.

validation_checks.assert: jq empty succeeds and every feature has stable identity, purpose, fallback, CTA, and acceptance data.
Production source contains no scroll-jacking, cursor trail, autoplay audio, fake scarcity, gradient mesh, or unverified 3D.
At 390x844, 768x1024, and 1440x900 documentElement.scrollWidth equals clientWidth; inner scrollers are labeled.
All core pages and critical states are captured at all three viewports with CTA, content order, crop, and no-obscured-content assertions.
Preference removes parallax/RAF/auto-rotate/WebGL/autoplay/stagger and preserves DOM, order, facts, and CTA reachability.
Skip, drawer, quick view, hotspots, media alternatives, dialogs, live regions, visible focus, Escape, and focus restoration pass.
Drawer, rails, gallery/360, hotspots, and CTA retain native scroll, pointer cancellation, 44px targets, and keyboard parity.
Observer, timer, RAF, listener, request, and decoded-buffer cleanup occurs on route, visibility, resize, pointer, Escape, and preference cancellation.
Unsupported/context-loss/timeout/offline/decode/abort paths retain poster, status, heading, facts, CTA, and keyboard reachability; no 390/reduced-motion canvas request.
Loading or disabled state appears within 100ms, response status within 1s, duplicate requests are prevented, and focus is retained or restored.
LCP, CLS, INP, frame health, long tasks, bytes, memory, and dropped frames meet the budget table; absent telemetry is UNKNOWN.
Source, captures, traces, commerce log, and independent reviews share candidate_id and feature_id before release-ready.
